subject: text labeling both value and names at sametime

messages.author: 6f7b392112a8650a
messages.subject: text labeling both value and names at sametime
parts:
Hi ggplot2 users:

I need to label with both names and values at the sametime:

for example think of it:

X1=c(-8, -4, 0, 4, 8, 10, 15)
X2=X1*0.8 + 10
names=c("A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F", "G")
datag <- data.frame(names, X1, X2)

ggplot() + geom_point(data = datag, aes(x = X1, y = X2), shape = 1,
alpha = 1) +
geom_text(data = datag, aes(x = X1, y = X2, lab = names),
size = 2.5, colour = 'red') + geom_text(data = datag, aes(x = X1, y =
X2, lab = X2), size = 2.5, colour = 'green4') + theme_bw()

I want position the name labels just in side not overlap, I tried with
position = "dodge" but did not work. Sorry for basic question however
your help is highly appreciated.

Ram
